programs.title: Dum
programs.desc: When a diligent aspiring policeman named Uday realises that his superior is a corrupt man, he takes it upon himself to fight corruption, so even if it means putting at risk his life and his dream of becoming an officer.

programs.title: Masti
programs.desc: Three henpecked friends tired of their respective marriage decide to spice up their lives by indulging in an extramarital affair. But things go downhill very quickly when they become the prime suspects in a deadly murder case.

programs.title: Veerey Ki Wedding
programs.desc: Veerey and Geet fall in love and decide to get married. Their plan gets tossed out of the window when her peace-loving father sees Veerey getting involved in a fight, if only to protect a girl, and stamps him as a violent roadside Romeo.
